title: Color Swatch Picker
statement: Build a color swatch picker. Clicking a swatch should select it and show its hex code, and only one swatch should ever be selected at a time.

rubric: Clicking a swatch visibly marks it as selected, e.g. with a border.
Selecting a new swatch clears the selected state from the previous one.
The hex readout updates to match whichever swatch was just clicked.
Only one swatch is ever selected at a time.
curveballs: Actually, show the hex code in white text on top of the selected swatch instead of below the grid.
Add a sixth swatch for a color of your choosing.
Make the selected swatch grow slightly larger instead of just getting a border.
